## Research Findings: Mod/Plugin Sourcing by Game (2026)

**1. 7 Days to Die** — No Steam Workshop as of Sept 2026. It was slated for "Update 3" (Q4 2025) but has slipped; community says Fun Pimps roadmap dates are routinely wrong ([discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/251570/discussions/0/558747921975928418), [Workshop page still empty](https://steamcommunity.com/app/251570/workshop/)). Real non-Nexus source: the community-run **7D2D Mod Launcher** (7d2dmodlauncher.org, open-source, actively maintained — GitHub release 5.5.0.10 dated Aug 25 2026), which auto-downloads/version-matches overhauls and modlets (Darkness Falls, War3zuk AIO, Undead Legacy) directly from author GitHub repos/Discords rather than gating through personal Nexus logins. See [7D2D Mod Launcher wiki](https://7d2dmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/7D2D_Mod_Launcher) and [7d2d.net/modlauncher-download](https://7d2d.net/modlauncher-download). SDX is an older community mod-compiling toolchain ([sdxmod.com](http://sdxmod.com/docs.html)), still used by some overhauls but not a distribution hub itself.

**2. Terraria / tModLoader** — Since the 1.4 Steam merge, tModLoader's built-in "Mod Browser" is now effectively a client for **Steam Workshop** rather than the standalone server it ran pre-Steam ([GitHub issue #1276, "Integrate Steam Workshop with Mod Browser"](https://github.com/tModLoader/tModLoader/issues/1276); [Steam Workshop page](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1281930/workshop/)). Only mods for the current default branch are listed on Workshop; mods can also be sideloaded as `.tmod` files or built from source off GitHub, bypassing Workshop entirely — a legitimate non-Nexus path for a hosting catalog. Confirmed via [terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/TModLoader](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/TModLoader).

**3. Squad** — Official, developer-supported: Offworld Industries ships the **Squad SDK**, and mods are published straight to Steam Workshop via the SDK's "Upload to Steam Workshop" button ([Squad SDK wiki](https://squad.fandom.com/wiki/Squad_SDK), [Releasing a Mod](https://squad.fandom.com/wiki/Releasing_a_Mod)). Fully Steam-native, no Nexus dependency.

**4. Insurgency: Sandstorm** — Official Mod Tools were made public in **Update 1.6** ([Steam news](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/581320/view/3300515414502124171)). Distribution is Steam Workshop (maps, mutators, full conversions like ISMC 2), with mod.io also hosting for cross-play ([mod.io/g/insurgencysandstorm](https://mod.io/g/insurgencysandstorm)). Legitimate, non-Nexus, developer-sanctioned.

**5. Enshrouded** — No Steam Workshop, no official SDK/mod tools from Keen even post-1.0; claims of upcoming official tools have no source from the studio ([Steam discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1203620/discussions/0/4142816460196006041)). The active scene is small (~100 items) Lua-based loaders (e.g., EML) altering game data, hosted almost entirely on **Nexus Mods** ([Enshrouded Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/enshrouded/mods/91)) — i.e., nothing viable beyond the excluded Nexus gate.

**6. Sunkenland** — No Steam Workshop. Modding runs on **BepInEx**, with mods hosted on **Thunderstore** (thunderstore.io/c/sunkenland) in addition to Nexus. Thunderstore is a public, ungated CDN-style mod repository (no personal end-user login required to pull files), making it a genuinely viable non-Nexus source for a hosting catalog ([Thunderstore Sunkenland](https://thunderstore.io/c/sunkenland/)).

**7. Abiotic Factor** — No Steam Workshop currently. Official mod support ("Community Update #5 – The Modding Update") is in development: an in-game browser integrated with **mod.io**, plus a standalone free Mod Editor, but it had not shipped as of this research (still described as "coming soon") ([Steam discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/427410/discussions/0/4700160645247964980/)). Currently mods are manual-install, hosted on Nexus and [ModWorkshop.net](https://modworkshop.net/g/abiotic-factor). Once CU5 ships, mod.io becomes the legitimate non-Nexus path — worth flagging as "pending," not yet actionable.

**8. Core Keeper** — Steam Workshop is live in **open beta** via the "Void & Voltage" update (announced Feb 2026) ([Steam news](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1621690/view/517480275699042154)). Mods also on **mod.io** (QoL mods like InstantPortalCharge) ([mod.io/g/corekeeper](https://mod.io/g/corekeeper)). Legitimate Steam-native source, though still beta-flagged — version-pinning caution advised for hosted servers.

**9. Icarus** — Steam Workshop is supported directly (RocketWerkz built mod hooks into the engine), with a smaller catalog than ARK — "dozens, not thousands" of mods, mostly building/QoL/balance tweaks ([Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1149460)). Dedicated servers require manually copying `.pak` files, and multi-mod setups need the community **Icarus Mod Manager (IMM)** to merge mods. Legitimate, Steam-native, no Nexus dependency needed.

**10. Soulmask** — Steam Workshop went officially live per a Dec 2025 developer announcement, alongside the official **Modkits** developer toolkit (public since late Dec 2024) ([Steam news announcement](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4702410905632601734), [Modkits wiki](https://soulmask.fandom.com/wiki/Modkits_Overview)). Fully legitimate, developer-endorsed, Steam-native — one of the cleanest cases in this list.

**11. Dragonwilds (RuneScape: Dragonwilds, Jagex)** — No official mod tools or Steam Workshop; Jagex has only published Community Modding Guidelines permitting community mods, with Workshop support reportedly deferred until after Early Access ([Steam discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1374490/discussions/0/604161119746074336/)). Modding is UE4SS/`.pak`-based; the primary hub (414 mods) is **Nexus Mods** — gated, no viable alternative found yet.

**12. Nightingale** — Modding scene is minimal and Nexus-only, with no Steam Workshop planned ("no mods available" per [Steam discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1928980/discussions/0/595161733884202358/)). Additional context relevant to a hosting business: Inflexion Games has had layoffs, closed its UK office, and is moving away from centralized hosted server infrastructure toward player/self-hosting, with concurrent players down to roughly 315/day as of mid-2025 ([PCGamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/survival-crafting/despite-making-significant-changes-to-survival-game-nightingale-developer-inflexion-games-says-it-hasnt-been-commercially-successful-enough-to-avoid-dozens-of-layoffs/), [MMORPG.com](https://www.mmorpg.com/news/after-dedicated-servers-ptr-nightingale-moving-away-from-hosted-centralized-online-play-2000135491)) — the game's viability as a hosted product is itself in question, independent of modding.

**13. Eco** — Real, non-Nexus ecosystem: Strange Loop Games maintains the official **EcoModKit** on GitHub ([github.com/StrangeLoopGames/EcoModKit](https://github.com/StrangeLoopGames/EcoModKit)), and individual modders distribute finished mods via their own public GitHub repos (e.g., [AlexDocking/Eco-Mods](https://github.com/AlexDocking/Eco-Mods), TheKye's Elixr Mods, Kirthos, CoFH). No central workshop, but fully open/ungated GitHub distribution — usable for a hosting catalog.

**14. Empyrion – Galactic Survival** — Long-established, fully functional **Steam Workshop** ([workshop hub](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/about/?appid=383120)), covering ship/base blueprints, full total-conversion scenarios (Reforged Eden, Project Eden), and script mods (manual install). Steam-native, no Nexus dependency; Skymods also mirrors ([catalogue.smods.ru](https://catalogue.smods.ru/game/empyrion-galactic-survival/)).

### Quick-reference summary
- **Clean, official, Steam-native today:** Squad, Insurgency: Sandstorm, Soulmask, Core Keeper (beta), Icarus, Empyrion.
- **Real non-Nexus alternative exists (GitHub/Thunderstore/mod.io):** 7 Days to Die (Mod Launcher), Sunkenland (Thunderstore), Eco (GitHub ModKit), tModLoader (Workshop + GitHub sideload).
- **Official tooling announced but not yet shipped:** Abiotic Factor (mod.io via CU5).
- **Nothing viable beyond Nexus (or nothing at all):** Enshrouded, Dragonwilds, Nightingale (and Nightingale carries additional business risk given the studio's contraction).
